mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 5% over three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a deepening economic contraction, which reduces corporate earnings and increases recession risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 falls below -2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressure and input costs, compressing profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods of sustained UNRATE above 6%.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in INDPRO below its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for four consecutive months indicates weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12M MA by > 3% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of persistent INDPRO weakness relative to its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both GDPC1 and HOUST above their 12-month moving averages by more than 2% in the same month signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12M MA by > 2% AND HOUST > 12M MA by > 2% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 12M MA by more than 2% simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% combined with a concurrent rise in CPIAUCSL above 4% for three consecutive months signals a breakdown in monetary policy transmission, which erodes real yields and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% AND CPIAUCSL > 4% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) during episodes of FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL > 4% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in PAYEMS below its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for five consecutive months signals weakening employment, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 12M MA by > 1% for 5 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods of sustained PAYEMS weakness relative to its 12M MA.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average by more than 5% in a single month signals a surge in household savings that exceeds spending, which dampens aggregate demand and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 12M MA by > 5% in a single month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when RSAFS rises above its 12M MA by more than 5% in a single month.
